fullContentHtml:
SAV Bihar Class 6 Pre Admit Card Date 2027-28 – Full Details

Bihar School Examination Board (BSEB) has released the Pre Admit Card Date for the Exam of Class 6 (VI) in Simultala Awasiya Vidyalaya (SAV), Simultala Jamui, Bihar To The Academic Session 2027-28 Admission on the official website of the BSEB recently. Applications for the SAV Bihar Class 6 Online Form 2026 were accepted from 03 August 2026, to 28 August 2026. The written examination is going to be conducted on 24 October 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SAV Bihar Class 6 Pre Admit Card 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 03 August 2026
  • Last Date : 28 August 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Dummy Admit Card : 09 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 24 October 2026
  • Pre Admit Card Available : 09 October2026

Application Fee

  • General/ BC / EBC / EWS : Rs. 200/-
  • SC/ ST Candidates : Rs. 50/-

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Click on the official Admit Card link given below.
  2. Login using your Application Number / Roll Number and Password / DOB.
  3. Your Admit Card will be displayed on screen.
  4. Download the PDF and take a clear printout to carry to the exam venue.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)

What is SAV Bihar Class 6 Pre Admit Card Date 2027-28?

SAV Bihar Class 6 Pre Admit Card Date 2027-28 is the official hall ticket for the upcoming examination. Candidates must carry it along with a valid photo ID to the exam centre.

All verified official links are available in the Important Links table above on this page.
